definition.unit: consecutive clean SCHEDULED cycles (per OPAL_CONSOLIDATION_PRD.md:181 -- 'N consecutive scheduled cycles')
definition.deliverable_scope: EXPANDED TO 9 KEYS 2026-07-21 (Andrew-direct, see cutover_status.scope_9_and_census). = aggregate_aua_timeseries {49financial,inflection,global} + account_distribution {49financial,inflection,global} + non_model_assets (A4, global) + aum_metrics (global) + aum_timeseries (global). account_distribution is ANDREW-MANDATED in-scope (2026-07-21). aum_metrics + aum_timeseries were TO-2 (deferred) but Andrew ruled the WHOLE Portfolio Analytics view must serve off opal-data-assets -> TO-2 PULLED FORWARD, produced off the revamp aggregate, IN the 9-key deliverable + the streak. (Rationale: the FE reads aum-metrics for the Portfolio Analytics metric cards + aum-timeseries for the Global AUM Daily Trend value/enterprise-Total; leaving them legacy = a mixed-basis Global Total.)
definition.scheduled_only: A HAND-STAGED run does NOT count (NEVER rule: validate on the scheduled nightly's artifacts, not ad-hoc). The count advances ONLY on a scheduled-cycle artifact set that all THREE independent passes recorded CLEAN.
definition.reset_rule: An UNEXPLAINED delta in any pass RESETS the streak to 0/3 (PRD:184). A named delta (in DS's ledger) does NOT reset.
definition.no_silent_pass: A scheduled cycle with NO recorded 3-pass verification is NOT counted -- it is a GAP to fill, never a silent pass. Missing verification != clean.
definition.cutover_gate: streak == 3 clean scheduled cycles AND the never-widen co-sign package (CTO+COO+Andrew) -> then S5 cutover (arm publisher, gold->portal). Publisher stays OFF until this fires.
